environment.models: release-pinned, cached; no downloads in timed runs
environment.execution: sequential isolated subprocesses; no concurrent development tests/builds during final comparison

method: Three fresh runs per recording and profile. Aggregate is the sum of per-recording medians. Earlier incomplete-cache runs are excluded. Desktop load, thermal state, and memory pressure can still affect results.
